title: Nokware Ahengua no
intro: Sodifo bi a ɔwɔ tumi a wonim no sɛ ɔwɔ nyansa kɛse ne n’ahengua a ɛyɛ nwonwa no nya ahintasɛm nkrasɛm bi fi baabi a wonnim. Saa nkitahodi a wɔnhwɛ kwan yi twa wɔn gyidi ne tumidi ho mpoa, na ɛde wɔn kɔ aman ntam kwan so akwantu a ɛbɛsɔ wɔn adwene ahwɛ na awiei koraa no ɛde honhom mu nyane a emu dɔ aba. So wubetumi ahu onii ko a ɔhene yi yɛ ne nsɛm a esisii a ɛsakraa wɔn ahenni nyinaa?
clues: Me ne me nkurɔfo som owia, na yedii yɛn nananom akwan akyi.
Ná anomaa, hoopoe, ne ɔbɔfo a ɛnyɛ nea ɛda adi sɛ ɔde krataa a efi ɔkannifo bi a ɔwɔ tumi hɔ brɛɛ me.
Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mɛsɔ nea ɔsomaa no nyansa ahwɛ no, mede akyɛde ahorow a ɛsom bo kɔmaa, nanso wɔsan de bae, efisɛ na nea ɔsomaa no no wɔ ahonyade a ɛsen saa koraa a efi Allah hɔ.
Ansa na meredu nea ɔsomaa no no ahemfie mpo no, wɔde m’ahengua a ɛyɛ nwonwa no kɔɔ hɔ anwonwakwan so wɔ aniwa mu.
Bere a miduu hɔ no, wobisaa me sɛ ebia ahengua a wɔde fa nnipa no yɛ me dea anaa, na mibuae sɛ, ‘Ɛte sɛ nea ɛno ankasa.’
Mehyɛnee asa kɛseɛ bi a ɛwɔ fam a medii mfomsoɔ sɛ ɛyɛ nsuo atare, na saa berɛ a na ɛyɛ hu no, mede me ho hyɛɛ Ɔkɔmhyɛni Sulaiman nkyɛn maa Allah, wiase nyinaa Awurade.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
